items.title: File Widerspruch against Pflegegrad decision
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 28.03.2025; assuming it was handed to the post on the same day (Aufgabe zur Post), § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X deems it delivered on the third day after posting: 29.03 (Sat, day 1) + 30.03 (Sun, day 2) + 31.03 (Mon, day 3) = Bekanntgabe on 31.03.2025 (a Monday, no weekend/holiday shift needed). The one-month Widerspruch period then runs per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2, 3 BGB (via § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X): the period begins the day after Bekanntgabe (01.04.2025) and ends one month later on the day of the following month numerically corresponding to the Bekanntgabe day (31.03) — since April has no 31st day, § 188 Abs. 3 BGB moves the end to the last day of April, i.e. 30.04.2025 (a Wednesday, not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday in NRW, so it stands).

warnings: The Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery) date is computed assuming the letter was posted on its printed date (28.03.2025); if it was actually mailed later, the one-month Widerspruch deadline shifts accordingly and should be re-checked against the actual postmark/envelope date.

The requested Pflegegrad 3 was denied (only Pflegegrad 2 granted, 38.75 weighted points) based on the MD assessment of 12.03.2025 — the person may want to review that assessment before deciding on a Widerspruch.
